{{Quote|No. I'm an unarmed combat instructor. Partus over there, she's the one with the red face, is a navigator. That's someone who tells the ship how to get where it's going. Dewback Kord over there, he's a ship’s mechanic. No, when it's time to leave, we all hop in a shuttle and go up.|Rondle|<ref name="WS" />}}
'''Partus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] for [[Hawkbat (starship)|''Hawkbat'']], a [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. Partus and a few of the ''Hawkbat''{{'s}} crew were treated to drinks by [[Yokel Group]], members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], during their [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]] in order to gather information.<ref name="WS" />
